title: Intake Visits in a Rehabilitation Therapy Course
content:
## Intake visits in a therapy course

**Clause.** Under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, a rehabilitation therapy course keeps intake visits at the copay booked on them, the category's outpatient hospital copay; they are not re-rated. How many intake visits a course keeps follows how the course was requested, as the member's rehabilitation therapy authorization in the Prior Authorization records shows it:

- A course a provider requested from an in-network servicing provider keeps 1 intake visit (the in-network intake visit count).
- A course a provider requested from an out-of-network servicing provider keeps 2 intake visits (the out-of-network intake visit count).
- Any other course, such as one carried over from a previous plan or approved on a retroactive request, keeps no intake visit.

No more intake visits are kept than the course holds.

## Table

| How the authorization was requested | Network status of the servicing provider | Intake visits kept |
|---|---|---|
| Provider request | In network | 1 |
| Provider request | Out of network | 2 |
| Carried over from a previous plan | Any | 0 |
| Retroactive request | Any | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A provider-requested course with an out-of-network servicing provider holds six visits: 2 are kept as intake visits at the copay booked on them.
- The same kind of course holds a single visit: only that 1 visit is kept, because no more intake visits are kept than the course holds.
- A course carried over from the member's previous plan holds six visits: none is an intake visit.
